# EMA Recovers the Old System

## Principle
EMA should not act as though the old Discord/OpenClaw/QMD/vault system was a wrong turn.

## Better framing
EMA should recover:
- the old system's practical strengths
- its operational feel
- its continuity mechanisms
- its query and memory substrate

and then reconcile those into a cleaner, more explicit, more native EMA shape.
